title: Recognized Mum & Dad's Voices
desc: You turned your head toward us when we called your name — you knew exactly who we were.
story: Nine weeks old and something shifted. Dad called your name softly from across the room, and your little head turned, slowly and deliberately, right toward him. We tried it again with Mum's voice. Same thing. You knew us. Not just our touch or our smell, but our voices specifically. The same voices that had been talking to you through the bump for all those months. We had always been familiar to you, and somehow that felt like the most wonderful thing in the world.
